items.source: Create a file called application.yaml and put it in the root of your classpath. Then add snakeyaml to your dependencies (Maven coordinates org.yaml:snakeyaml, already included if you use the spring-boot-starter). A YAML file is parsed to a Java Map<String,Object> (like a JSON object), and Spring Boot flattens the map so that it is one level deep and has period-separated keys, as many people are used to with Properties files in Java.
items.translation: 创建一个名为 application.yaml` 的文件并将其放在类路径的根目录中。然后在依赖项中添加 `snakeyaml`（Maven 坐标为 `org.yaml:snakeyaml`，如果您使用 `spring-boot-starter，则已包含）。YAML 文件会被解析为 Java `Map<String,Object>（类似于 JSON 对象），Spring Boot 会将该映射展平，使其只有一层深度并使用点分隔的键，就像许多人所习惯的 Java 中 `Properties` 文件一样。

items.source: If you inherit from the spring-boot-starter-parent POM, the default filter token of the maven-resources-plugins has been changed from ${*} to @ (that is, @maven.token@ instead of ${maven.token}) to prevent conflicts with Spring-style placeholders. If you have enabled Maven filtering for the application.properties directly, you may want to also change the default filter token to use other delimiters.
items.translation: 如果您继承自 spring-boot-starter-parent POM，maven-resources-plugins 的默认过滤器标记已从 ${*} 更改为 @（即使用 @maven.token@ 而非 ${maven.token}），以防止与 Spring 风格的占位符发生冲突。 如果您已直接为 application.properties 启用了 Maven 过滤，您可能也想将默认过滤器标记更改为使用其他分隔符。

items.source: If you enable the addResources flag, the spring-boot:run goal can add src/main/resources directly to the classpath (for hot reloading purposes). Doing so circumvents the resource filtering and this feature. Instead, you can use the exec:java goal or customize the plugin’s configuration. See the plugin usage page for more details.
items.translation: 如果启用 addResources 标志，spring-boot:run 目标可以直接将 src/main/resources 添加到类路径中（用于热重载目的）。 这样做会绕过资源过滤和此功能。 相反，您可以使用 exec:java 目标或自定义插件的配置。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅插件使用页面。

items.source: Gradle’s expand method uses Groovy’s SimpleTemplateEngine, which transforms ${..} tokens. The ${..} style conflicts with Spring’s own property placeholder mechanism. To use Spring property placeholders together with automatic expansion, escape the Spring property placeholders as follows: \${..}.
items.translation: Gradle 的 expand 方法使用 Groovy 的 SimpleTemplateEngine，该引擎会转换 ${..} 标记。 ${..} 样式与 Spring 自身的属性占位符机制冲突。 若要同时使用 Spring 属性占位符和自动扩展功能，请按以下方式转义 Spring 属性占位符：\${..}。

items.source: The useDefaultDelimiters property is important if you use standard Spring placeholders (such as ${placeholder}) in your configuration. If that property is not set to false, these may be expanded by the build.
items.translation: 如果您在配置中使用标准的 Spring 占位符（例如 ${placeholder}），则 useDefaultDelimiters 属性非常重要。如果该属性未设置为 false，构建过程可能会展开这些占位符。

items.source: If you want detailed information about the files that are being loaded you can set the logging level of org.springframework.boot.context.config to trace.
items.translation: 如果您需要有关正在加载的文件的详细信息，可以org.springframework.boot.context.config的日志级别设置为trace。
